_warning: ILLUSTRATIVE DATA — no real supporter appears in this file. It stands in for the bi-weekly spreadsheet the team receives, so the import walkthrough can be judged against a file that behaves like the real one.
_why_these_rows: Every row here earns its place by being a case the importer has to DECIDE something about. A file of fourteen clean rows would let the walkthrough claim a success it never has to work for, and would hide the four questions this whole review exists to ask. The first six are ordinary. The rest are the ones that make an importer either honest or lossy.
_columns_note: Four columns, and that is the whole file. There is no amount column, no founding column, and no anonymity column — which is exactly why tier, founding and anonymous cannot be derived here no matter how good the matching is.
